title: What Does the Bible Say About Pornography? 28 Verses
description: What the Bible says about pornography: Jesus on looking with lust, Job's covenant with his eyes, fleeing sexual immorality and the way back.
keywords: what does the bible say about pornography
bible verses about lust and purity
how to stop watching porn bible verses
summary: The word pornography does not appear in the World English Bible or the King James Version (0 verses); the Bible speaks instead of lust (65 verses), sexual immorality (28 verses of the World English Bible) and the eyes. Jesus says anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery in the heart and that it is better to lose a body part than the whole body in hell (Matthew 5:27-30). Job makes a covenant with his eyes (Job 31:1), the psalmist refuses to set worthless things before his eyes (Psalm 101:3), and Paul tells believers to flee sexual immorality (1 Corinthians 6:18) and to put to death what is earthly in them (Colossians 3:5). The verses also cover the way back: confession, cleansing and a new mind (1 John 1:9, Romans 12:2).

faqs.q: Is pornography a sin according to the Bible?
faqs.a: The Bible does not name it, but its teaching on lust (Matthew 5:28), sexual immorality (Ephesians 5:3) and the eyes (Job 31:1, Psalm 101:3) is applied to it by nearly every Christian tradition. Hebrews 13:4 and 1 Thessalonians 4:3-5 give the positive side: honor in marriage and self-control.

faqs.q: What does Jesus say about looking with lust?
faqs.a: 'Everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart' (Matthew 5:28). He then says to remove whatever causes the stumbling, using strong language to say that sin is worth drastic action.

faqs.q: Can I be forgiven for looking at pornography?
faqs.a: Yes. 'If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness' (1 John 1:9), and God does not deal with us as our sins deserve (Psalm 103:10-12). Hebrews 4:15-16 invites the tempted to come boldly for mercy.

faqs.q: What Bible verses help with temptation?
faqs.a: 1 Corinthians 10:13 says God provides a way of escape, 2 Timothy 2:22 says to flee youthful lusts, Philippians 4:8 gives what to think about instead, and Psalm 119:37 asks God to turn the eyes from worthless things. Asking for help from another believer is the pattern in James 5:16.
